parsed.explanation: The inference "|E|<|V| ⇒ no cycle/loop anywhere" is invalid: |E|<|V| only forces SOME component to be acyclic, not all. The objection's instance is legitimate: n=1, pieces 2/3, 1/3; Xiang splits 2/3 into 1/3+1/3; M=3, |E|=1<2=|V|, and the permitted arbitrary tie-break pairs the two halves of piece 1, giving a loop at vertex n=1. Then T (the component containing n) is not a tree, has no proper 2-colouring, and the displayed expansion of Ξ (opposite signs, distinct endpoints) is unavailable. Lemma 4 is the only place the lower bound is argued, so L3.3 is not established as written. A one-sentence fix — choose any component with |E_T|<|V_T| (it is a tree) and apply (3.1), which holds for every nonempty J — suffices.
